name: Fresh Paneer
description: Fresh Indian cottage cheese with high moisture and fat content. Highly perishable without adequate moisture and oxygen barriers.

name: Turmeric Powder
description: Dried and ground turmeric. Light-sensitive (curcumin degrades under UV/visible light). Low moisture, moderate fat.

name: Ghee
description: Clarified butter with very high fat content. Highly susceptible to oxidative rancidity. Requires excellent oxygen and light barrier.

name: Basmati Rice (Raw)
description: Long-grain aromatic rice. Low fat, moderate moisture. Primary spoilage risk: moisture ingress and insect infestation.

name: Fresh Spinach
description: Leafy green vegetable with very high respiration rate. Requires modified atmosphere packaging (MAP) with adequate O₂ permeability.

name: Dried Red Chilli
description: Whole or crushed dried chilli peppers. Colour (capsanthin) and pungency degrade under light. Moderate fat and moisture.

name: Groundnut Oil
description: Edible vegetable oil. Pure fat — extremely susceptible to oxidative rancidity. Requires maximum oxygen and light barrier.

name: Whole Wheat Flour (Atta)
description: Stoneground whole wheat flour. Prone to moisture absorption and insect attack. Moderate moisture, low fat.

name: Masoor Dal (Red Lentils)
description: Dried split lentils. Low fat, low moisture, robust structure. Mainly moisture and insect protection required.

name: Amul Butter (Salted)
description: Salted table butter. High fat and moderate moisture. Needs strong oxygen, moisture, and light barriers.

name: Potato Wafers / Chips
description: Fried potato crisps. Very low moisture, high fat, extremely fragile (crush-sensitive). Needs nitrogen flush and rigid packaging.

name: Honey
description: Natural honey. High sugar concentration keeps aw low despite moderate moisture. Light degrades enzymes and colour. Primary risk: fermentation if aw rises.

name: Fresh Tomatoes
description: Climacteric fruit with moderate respiration. Sensitive to mechanical damage. Benefits from controlled atmosphere packaging.

name: Mango Pulp (Canned / Aseptic)
description: Processed mango pulp for B2B / industrial use. High moisture, heat-processed. Requires hermetic seal and corrosion-resistant packaging.

name: Cumin Seeds (Jeera)
description: Whole dried cumin seeds. High essential-oil fat content. Volatile aroma compounds require a good oxygen and light barrier to prevent loss.

name: Panipuri Shells (Gol Gappa)
description: Crispy fried hollow shells. Extremely fragile and crush-sensitive. Requires rigid or semi-rigid packaging with nitrogen flushing.

name: Jaggery (Gur)
description: Unrefined cane sugar product. Hygroscopic — absorbs atmospheric moisture readily, causing stickiness and microbial growth. Moderate aw.

name: Milk Powder (Skimmed)
description: Spray-dried skimmed milk. Extremely hygroscopic. Light accelerates vitamin degradation and flavour changes. Low fat but very moisture-sensitive.

name: Dry Roasted Peanuts
description: Dry-roasted groundnuts. High fat — primary spoilage is oxidative rancidity. Low moisture. Nitrogen flushing and low-OTR packaging recommended.

name: Banana (Fresh)
description: Climacteric tropical fruit. Moderate respiration at room temperature; ripening is ethylene-triggered. Fragile skin.
